issueRegistry.title: Landmark geometry obscures driving after recovery near Mecca Masjid
issueRegistry.confidence: high for observed obstruction; causal chain unproven
issueRegistry.nextStep: Repeat using visible controls; test recovery destination clearance, facade-pier collision coverage, and camera fallback. Do not assume all landmark colliders are absent.

issueRegistry.nextStep: Repeat a slow approach/reverse alongside large traffic and save before/during/after frames.

issueRegistry.nextStep: Follow intended ground-level turn; compare actual drivable lane and ribbon. Pickup reachability is not disproven.

issueRegistry.nextStep: Trap focus within map and make background controls inert while it is open; retest Shift+Tab, Tab, Escape and actual Close.

issueRegistry.title: Pausing immediately after handover can leave the next offer missing
issueRegistry.confidence: High for repeated visible failure and workaround in Ameerpet and Kukatpally; callback cause strongly source-supported, not instrumented.
issueRegistry.nextStep: Run completed-handover no-pause control, then regression-test the immediate-pause case after an authorized fix. No gameplay behavior changed in this audit.
issueRegistry.workaround: Pause → Change area → Stay here restored offers in both observed areas without relocating.
issueRegistry.latestAttempt: Dilsukh resumed collected order but stopped120m before handover; no-pause control remains untested.

browserCoordination: Parent grants exclusive browser turns; only the active owner sends input. Workers used per-call input locks; root used its explicit exclusive lease. Pause and release all held input before handoff; never interact with another owner’s game tab.
evidenceCapture: Use screenshots supported by the browser tool. tools/playtest-evidence-server.py provides a localhost-only browser form to save screenshot bytes when no file-save API exists. Read its random form URL from its startup output; do not reuse a stale URL.

interpretationRules: A completed bounded test pass is partial area coverage, not proof of a whole region.
Observed-once and suspected findings need another controlled attempt before promotion.
Report actual held-input time and wall time separately; neither paused time nor tool latency is uninterrupted gameplay.
Record route-distance increases after wrong turns without labeling the GPS broken unless a legal-route mismatch is reproduced.
An empty console log does not exclude visual or gameplay bugs.
